title: The Stone Snatched from the Kaaba: Twenty-One Years of Absence
summary: Recounts how, on the eleventh of January, nine hundred thirty, Abu Tahir al-Jannabi, leader of the Qarmatian state in Bahrain, entered Mecca disguised as a pilgrim during the hajj season, plundered the city for eight days, and pried the Black Stone from the wall of the Kaaba to carry it off to Hasa. The episode takes up how this raid, which closed the pilgrimage route for years, laid bare just how far the Abbasid caliphate had rotted, and the stone's return when it was left at Kufa in nine hundred fifty-one.
